pages.text: Follow moves after the owner; Wait pauses ordinary work. All new companions wait, including Creative defaults and first specialization. Recovered companions retain their saved order.

Mining uses Mine, carriers Haul, heralds Watch, combat and dragons Fight, cleaners Clean, farmers Farm, and lumberjacks Chop. Healers use Search, warehouses Store, fishers Fish, abundance Nurture, and tunnelers Tunnel. Soggy and Meow Slimes can Roam; Meow activation is independent.

Primary and shared owners may manage or recover a companion. Giving a recovered item to someone else does not change ownership. Workers, healers, and carriers cooperate within the same owner’s team or between mutually shared owners.
